project_type: Nim compiler/DSL parser for the Doot web framework
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'nimble build' to confirm compilation. 2. Run 'nimble test' to confirm all tests pass. 3. Verify the parser can parse the example blog files in examples/blog/.
setup_instructions: 1. Install Nim via choosenim: curl https://nim-lang.org/choosenim/init.sh -sSf | sh. 2. Add ~/.nimble/bin to PATH. 3. Verify with 'nim --version' and 'nimble --version'.
environment_constraints: Nim is NOT pre-installed. Must install via choosenim or direct download. Network is OPEN_INTERNET so package installs are fine.
contribution_requirements: Work on branch feat/phase-1-parser branched from docs/architecture-and-implementation-plan. Follow the spec exactly as described in docs/.
key_patterns: Handwritten recursive-descent parser with three parse modes (route/schema, template, native). Whitespace-significant templates (Pug-style, 2-space indent, spaces only). Keyword-delimited blocks (do...end) for routes/schema. String interpolation via #{}. Multi-file resolution starting from app.do. Error recovery to report multiple errors.
directory_structure: Root: /projects/sandbox/Doot/. Currently has docs/ (14 design docs), doot-v1-spec.md, README.md. Implementation will create: src/ (compiler source), tests/ (unit tests), examples/ (sample .do projects), doot.nimble (project file).
